entries.title: Campus Coffee Run
entries.subtitle: Same-day delivery across campus
entries.description: Barista-made coffee and pastries delivered to your res, library desk or lecture hall in under 30 minutes. Order via the app and pay with your student card.

entries.title: Budget Meal Prep Boxes
entries.subtitle: Five dinners for the week
entries.description: Weekly box of pre-portioned ingredients and recipes sized for one or two people. Cheapest per-meal option on the platform and vegetarian friendly.

entries.title: Late Night Groceries
entries.subtitle: 24/7 convenience store delivery
entries.description: Milk, bread, airtime, painkillers and snacks delivered by scooter between 20:00 and 03:00. Flat R15 delivery within 5 km of campus.

entries.title: FixMyLaptop Repairs
entries.subtitle: Student-run laptop and phone repair
entries.description: Screen replacements, battery swaps, virus cleanups and data recovery. Free diagnostics on campus, 48-hour turnaround on most repairs.

entries.title: Shuttle to Joburg
entries.subtitle: Weekend intercity shuttle
entries.description: Friday afternoon and Sunday evening shuttle between Bloemfontein and Johannesburg. Wi-Fi on board, 20 kg luggage included, seat selection in the app.

entries.title: Campus Bike Share
entries.subtitle: Unlock a bike, ride, park it
entries.description: Monthly pass for 200+ shared bicycles and e-bikes around campus. Includes helmet locker access and puncture insurance.

entries.title: Airport Transfer
entries.subtitle: Private car to Bram Fischer
entries.description: Reliable private transfers to and from Bram Fischer International Airport. Fixed pricing, flight tracking, child seats on request.

entries.title: Print & Bind Station
entries.subtitle: Thesis printing while you wait
entries.description: A3 and A4 laser printing, colour covers, spiral and perfect binding. Upload the PDF, collect in two hours, pay only on collection.

entries.title: Secondhand Textbook Market
entries.subtitle: Preloved textbooks, verified sellers
entries.description: Marketplace of used textbooks with condition photos, seller ratings and a meet-up point on campus. Average saving of 55% against new prices.

entries.title: Notes Exchange
entries.subtitle: Share and buy verified class notes
entries.description: Students upload summaries and past papers per module; peers buy them for credits. Moderated for accuracy by top students in each faculty.

entries.title: Tutor Matching
entries.subtitle: Find a tutor for your module
entries.description: Matched to a postgraduate tutor in under 5 minutes. Online or on campus sessions, per-hour pricing, first session free.

entries.title: Code Bootcamp
entries.subtitle: Evening software bootcamp
entries.description: Twelve-week part-time bootcamp covering Python, Git, APIs and cloud basics. Portfolio-based assessment, payment plans available.

entries.title: CV and LinkedIn Desk
entries.subtitle: Human review in 24 hours
entries.description: A recruiter rewrites your CV, LinkedIn headline and cover letter. Includes ATS keyword check and one round of revisions.

entries.title: Weekend Barista Shift
entries.subtitle: Part-time work, no experience needed
entries.description: Paid barista shifts at partner cafés on Saturdays and Sundays, paid weekly. Training provided and transport allowance included.

entries.title: Gig Hub
entries.subtitle: Micro-jobs that pay in 48 hours
entries.description: Short tasks such as data capture, event staffing, promo work and deliveries. Verified employers only, and every gig shows an upfront payout.

entries.title: Student Wallet
entries.subtitle: Free digital pocket money account
entries.description: No-fee wallet with instant person-to-person payments, a savings pocket and spend insights by category. POPIA-compliant KYC in the app.

entries.title: Split the Bill
entries.subtitle: Split any payment instantly
entries.description: Points-of-sale across campus support split payments: everyone taps their share, and the store receives one settlement.

entries.title: Textbook Layby
entries.subtitle: Buy books over three payments
entries.description: Take the textbook now and pay it off over six weeks with no interest. Automated reminders and a small once-off admin fee.

entries.title: Cheap Data Bundles
entries.subtitle: Daily and weekly data deals
entries.description: Prepaid data bundles from all major networks, delivered as an eSIM QR code in seconds. Daily 1 GB from R15.

entries.title: Campus Wi-Fi Map
entries.subtitle: Find the fastest hotspot
entries.description: Crowd-sourced speed tests of every hotspot on and around campus, refreshed hourly. Offline bookmarking for saved spots.

entries.title: Roommate Finder
entries.subtitle: Verified student housing matches
entries.description: Verified listings near campus with rent, distance and photo galleries. Chat before you commit and report bad landlords.

entries.title: Laundry Loop
entries.subtitle: Wash, fold, deliver
entries.description: Weigh-and-go laundry with 24-hour turnaround. Track your bag with a QR code and pay per kilogram after collection.

entries.title: Gym Day Pass
entries.subtitle: Pay-as-you-go access
entries.description: Access 40 partner gyms with a day pass, no contract. Includes one group class and locker rental.

entries.title: 5-a-side League
entries.subtitle: Join a team this season
entries.description: Eight-week social football league with referees, kits and a prize for the winners. Free agent sign-up if you have no team.

entries.title: Mental Health Chat
entries.subtitle: Anonymous peer support line
entries.description: Trained counsellors and peer listeners available 18:00-02:00. Anonymous by default, with one-tap escalation to a crisis line.

entries.title: Clinic Booking
entries.subtitle: Book a campus clinic slot
entries.description: Book nurse or doctor appointments at the campus clinic and get reminders. Walk-in queue estimates are updated every 15 minutes.

entries.title: Event Tickets
entries.subtitle: Concerts and campus events
entries.description: Buy, transfer and resell tickets with anti-fraud QR codes that rotate every 30 seconds. Refunds handled in-app.

entries.title: Photographer for Hire
entries.subtitle: Grad and event photos
entries.description: Book a vetted photographer by the hour for graduations, birthdays and matric dances. Edited gallery delivered in 72 hours.

entries.title: Thrift Store Online
entries.subtitle: Preloved fashion, sorted by size
entries.description: Curated thrift drops every Thursday with exact measurements, condition ratings and a 48-hour return window.

entries.title: Hair Studio Bookings
entries.subtitle: Braids, fades and cuts
entries.description: Book a verified stylist by style and duration, with a deposit held in escrow until the appointment is confirmed.
